name: Lake Tangipahoa smoothed and estimated depth contours

metadata.method: Gaussian-smoothed signed distances to nested depth bands; intermediate levels are zero contours of averaged adjacent fields. Land is masked; no extrapolation beyond 16 ft.
metadata.georeferencing: Main Lake viewport ISO 32000 GPTS/LPTS; least-squares affine in the embedded projected CRS, then datum transformation to WGS84.
metadata.limitations: Historical 2016 depth bands, smoothed for display. 6, 10 and 14 ft lines are distance-based estimates, not surveyed depths. Smoothing may remove small features and shift lines. Source survey accuracy and water-surface datum are unspecified. No 18 or 20 ft contours: the source has no 20 ft boundary to support interpolation.
